japanese-kana.swsh: １ターンめに　うちゅうの　ちからを あつめることで　とくこうが　あがり ２ターンめに　あいてを　こうげきする。

korean.swsh: 1턴째에 우주의 힘을 모아서 특수공격을 올리고 2턴째에 상대를 공격한다.

traditional-chinese.swsh: 使用後的第１回合會聚集 宇宙的力量來提高特攻， 並於第２回合攻擊對手。

french.swsh: Le lanceur concentre l’énergie cosmique au premier tour, ce qui augmente son Attaque Spéciale, et frappe au second.

german.swsh: Der Anwender sammelt in Runde 1 kosmische Kräfte und erhöht damit seinen Spezial-Angriff, bevor er in Runde 2 das Ziel angreift.

spanish.swsh: El usuario dedica el primer turno a aumentar su Ataque Especial acumulando energía cósmica y lanza su ofensiva contra el objetivo en el segundo.

italian.swsh: Chi la usa accumula l’energia dello spazio nel primo turno per aumentare l’Attacco Speciale, quindi attacca nel turno successivo.

english.swsh: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers space power and boosts its Sp. Atk stat, then attacks the target on the next turn.
english.la: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers space power and boosts its Sp. Atk stat, then attacks the target on the next turn.
english.sv: The user gathers energy from space and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

japanese.swsh: １ターン目に　宇宙の　力を 集めることで　特攻が　あがり ２ターン目に　相手を　攻撃する。

simplified-chinese.swsh: 第１回合聚集宇宙之力提高特攻， 第２回合攻击对手。

latin-american-spanish.swsh: El usuario dedica el primer turno a aumentar su Ataque Especial acumulando energía cósmica y lanza su ofensiva contra el objetivo en el segundo.

effect.full: Requires a turn to charge before attacking. Raises the users Special Attack by 1 stage after the first turn.
effect.shortEffect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking. Raises the users Special Attack by 1 stage after the first turn.
